title: Rare Nanotyrannus skeleton found on Montana ranch could fetch up to $9 million
content: A rare find in the form of a nearly 70 percent complete Nanotyrannus skeleton, affectionately named Jodi, has been unearthed by rancher Jodi Pierson in Montana and is set to go under the hammer at Sotheby’s in New York on October 27.
